questions.question: Why should I tell the truth?
match_phrases: why should I tell the truth
why should I be honest
why is honesty important
why is lying bad
is it important to tell the truth
should I always tell the truth
questions.answer: Truth builds trust. When you speak honestly, people know they can depend on your words. Even when the truth is difficult, being honest gives you the courage to face things and make them right.

questions.question: Why should I help others?
match_phrases: why should I help others
why should we help people
why is helping others good
how can I help others
why is kindness important
should I help someone who needs me
questions.answer: Helping someone is a simple way to make the world a little better. You don't need to do something huge. A kind word, a helping hand, or sharing what you have can make someone's day brighter.

questions.question: What should I do when I am angry?
match_phrases: what should I do when I am angry
how do I control my anger
what should I do when I get mad
how can I calm down when angry
what do I do when my temper gets bad
questions.answer: When anger rises, don't let it choose your actions. Pause, take a few slow breaths, and give yourself time to calm down. Then speak about what happened without hurting yourself or someone else.

questions.question: What should I do when I feel sad?
match_phrases: what should I do when I feel sad
what can I do when I am sad
how do I deal with sadness
what if I feel like crying
what should I do when I am unhappy
questions.answer: It is okay to feel sad. You don't have to hide every difficult feeling. Talk to someone you trust, give yourself time, and remember that feelings can change. You don't have to face them alone.

questions.question: How do I stop being afraid?
match_phrases: how do I stop being afraid
what should I do when I am scared
how can I overcome fear
what should I do if something scares me
how can I be less afraid
questions.answer: Being brave does not mean never feeling afraid. Courage means taking the right step even when you feel afraid. Take a breath, understand what is frightening you, and ask a trusted person for help when you need it.

questions.question: What if my friend hurts me?
match_phrases: what if my friend hurts me
what should I do if my friend hurts me
my friend hurt my feelings
what if my friend is mean to me
should I hurt my friend back
my friend and I had a fight
questions.answer: First, don't rush to hurt them back. Tell your friend calmly that their words or actions hurt you. If the problem continues or you feel unsafe, talk to a trusted adult. A good friendship should have respect on both sides.

questions.question: Why shouldn't I be jealous?
match_phrases: why shouldn't I be jealous
why do I feel jealous
how can I stop being jealous
what should I do when I envy someone
why is jealousy bad
questions.answer: Jealousy makes us stare at what someone else has and forget what we have. Instead, appreciate your own journey and learn from others when you can. Someone else's success does not make yours smaller.

questions.question: What does it mean to be courageous?
match_phrases: what does courage mean
what does it mean to be brave
how can I be courageous
what is bravery
what makes someone courageous
questions.answer: Courage is doing what is right even when it feels difficult or frightening. Sometimes courage means speaking up, sometimes asking for help, and sometimes simply taking the next right step.

questions.question: Why should I be grateful?
match_phrases: why should I be grateful
why is gratitude important
why should I be thankful
what is the importance of gratitude
how can gratitude help me
questions.answer: Gratitude helps you notice the good things already around you. When you appreciate people, opportunities, and even small moments, your heart becomes less focused on what is missing.

questions.question: What does responsibility mean?
match_phrases: what does responsibility mean
what is responsibility
what does it mean to be responsible
why is responsibility important
what is my responsibility
questions.answer: Responsibility means taking care of what has been trusted to you and accepting the results of your choices. It means doing your part, even when nobody is reminding you.

questions.question: What should I do when I make a mistake?
match_phrases: what should I do when I make a mistake
what should I do when I do something wrong
how should I handle a mistake
what if I fail
how do I learn from mistakes
questions.answer: Don't hide from a mistake. Admit it, understand what went wrong, fix what you can, and learn from it. A mistake can become a lesson when you have the courage to learn from it.

questions.question: Why should I be patient?
match_phrases: why should I be patient
why is patience important
how can I be more patient
why do I have to wait
how do I learn patience
questions.answer: Not everything happens immediately. Patience gives you the space to think instead of reacting in a hurry. Good things often need time, practice, and steady effort.

questions.question: Is it okay to say no when something feels wrong?
match_phrases: can I say no if something feels wrong
is it okay to say no
what if something makes me uncomfortable
what if something feels unsafe
do I have to say yes
can I refuse something that feels wrong
questions.answer: Yes. You can say no when something feels unsafe, uncomfortable, or wrong. You do not have to obey a request just because someone asks. If you are unsure, move away and tell a trusted adult.

questions.question: How can I become a better person?
match_phrases: how can I become a better person
how can I be a good person
how do I improve myself
how can I become better
what makes someone a good person
questions.answer: Start with small choices: speak truthfully, treat people kindly, take responsibility, control your anger, and help when you can. Becoming better is not about being perfect. It is about choosing wisely, again and again.

questions.question: What should I do when someone hurts my feelings?
match_phrases: what should I do when someone hurts my feelings
someone hurt my feelings
what if someone's words hurt me
how do I deal with hurt feelings
what should I do when someone makes me upset
questions.answer: Your feelings matter. Take a moment to calm down, then tell the person how their words or actions affected you. If they keep hurting you or you feel unsafe, talk to someone you trust.

topics.title: The Golden Deer — Phishing & Fake Links

questions.question: How can I tell if a link is fake?
match_phrases: how can I tell if a link is fake
is this link fake
how do I know if a link is safe
how can I identify a phishing link
someone sent me a strange link
how do I know whether to click a link
how do I know if a link is bad
what if someone sends me a bad link
how to know a bad link
is this a bad link
questions.answer: Don't trust a link just because it looks exciting. Check who sent it, look carefully at the web address, and be suspicious if the message creates panic or promises an unbelievable prize. When you're unsure, ask a trusted adult before clicking.

questions.question: What should I check before clicking a link?
match_phrases: what should I check before clicking a link
what should I look at before clicking
should I click this link
how do I check a link before opening it
what should I check before opening a link
questions.answer: Pause first. Check the sender and the web address. Ask yourself why you received the link and whether the message is trying to make you act quickly. If you're not sure, don't click it—show it to a trusted adult.

questions.question: What if someone sends me a message saying I won a prize?
match_phrases: someone says I won a prize
I got a message saying I won
I won a prize message
is this prize message real
someone says I am a winner
I got a surprise prize message
questions.answer: A surprise prize can be tempting, but don't rush. It may be a trap. Check the sender and the link carefully, and never give away personal information just to claim a prize. When you're unsure, ask a trusted adult.

questions.question: Why do fake messages make me hurry?
match_phrases: why do scam messages make me hurry
why does a fake message say act now
why do scammers make things urgent
why do phishing messages create urgency
why does the message tell me to act quickly
questions.answer: Scammers often create urgency because they don't want you to stop and think. A message saying 'act now' or 'you will lose this chance' should make you pause, not panic.

questions.question: What should I do if I accidentally click a suspicious link?
match_phrases: I accidentally clicked a suspicious link
what if I clicked a bad link
I clicked a strange link by mistake
what should I do after clicking a suspicious link
I opened a suspicious link accidentally
questions.answer: Don't panic. Close the page and don't enter any information or download anything. Tell a trusted adult what happened so they can help you check the device and account.

questions.question: Why do I need a strong password?
match_phrases: why do I need a strong password
why should my password be strong
how does a strong password protect me
why are strong passwords important
questions.answer: A strong password makes it harder for someone else to get into your account. Use a password that is difficult to guess and don't share it with friends. A trusted adult can help you manage important passwords safely.

questions.question: Is my name and birth year a good password?
match_phrases: is my name a good password
can I use my birth year as a password
is my name and birthday a safe password
why is my name a weak password
can someone guess my password from my birthday
questions.answer: No. Your name and birth year can be easy for someone to guess. A strong password should not contain obvious personal information and should be difficult for others to predict.

questions.question: Can I use the same password everywhere?
match_phrases: can I use one password everywhere
should I use the same password for every account
is it okay to reuse passwords
can all my accounts have the same password
questions.answer: It's safer not to reuse the same password for every account. If one account is compromised, reused passwords can put your other accounts at risk.

questions.question: Should I write my password on a sticky note?
match_phrases: can I write my password on a sticky note
where should I keep my password
is it safe to write down my password
can I keep my password on paper
questions.answer: A password written where other people can easily see it is not safe. Keep passwords private and use a trusted password manager with adult guidance if you need help remembering them.

topics.title: The Permanent Path — Digital Footprints & Privacy

questions.question: Can something I delete from the internet really be gone?
match_phrases: is something deleted from the internet really gone
can I permanently delete something online
what happens when I delete a post
can deleted internet posts come back
can someone save something I deleted
questions.answer: Not always. Someone may have taken a screenshot, saved a copy, or shared it before you deleted it. That's why it is wise to think carefully before posting anything online.

questions.question: Should I share my school or location online?
match_phrases: should I share my school online
can I post my location
should I share my address online
is it safe to tell people where I go to school
should I share where I live online
questions.answer: Be careful with information that can reveal where you live, study, or spend time. Don't share your school, home address, daily routine, or precise location publicly. When in doubt, ask a trusted adult.

questions.question: Can I post my friend's photo without asking?
match_phrases: can I post my friend's photo
should I ask before posting someone's picture
can I share a friend's photo without permission
is it okay to post my friend's picture
questions.answer: It's better to ask your friend's permission first. Their photo belongs to their personal space too. Respecting someone's privacy is part of being a good digital citizen.

questions.question: Should I give an app my real name and phone number?
match_phrases: should I give an app my phone number
can I give an app my real name
why does an app need my phone number
is it safe to give an app my personal information
should I share personal information with an app
questions.answer: Don't share personal information automatically. First ask why the app needs it and whether the request is necessary. If you're a child, check with a parent or trusted adult before giving an app personal information.

questions.question: What should I do if someone is being bullied online?
match_phrases: what should I do if someone is bullied online
how can I help someone being bullied online
what if I see cyberbullying
someone is being bullied on the internet
how do I help an online bullying victim
questions.answer: Don't join in and don't encourage the bully. Support the person being hurt, save evidence if appropriate, report the harmful behavior, and tell a trusted adult.

questions.question: Should I fight back if someone bullies me online?
match_phrases: should I fight back against an online bully
should I bully the bully back
what should I do if someone bullies me online
should I take revenge on a cyberbully
questions.answer: No. Fighting back with more hurtful words can make the situation worse. Step away, block or report the person when appropriate, save evidence, and tell a trusted adult.

questions.question: When does a joke become bullying?
match_phrases: when does a joke become bullying
how do I know if teasing is bullying
when is a joke no longer funny
is teasing someone bullying
what if someone says it was just a joke
questions.answer: A joke stops being funny when it repeatedly hurts, humiliates, frightens, or targets someone—and the person being targeted isn't enjoying it. If someone says it hurts, listen and stop.

questions.question: Why can words hurt people online?
match_phrases: why do words hurt online
can online words really hurt people
why do comments hurt feelings
why can messages hurt someone
questions.answer: A screen doesn't remove someone's feelings. Words can still make a person feel embarrassed, frightened, or lonely. Before you post, pause and ask: would I say this kindly if the person were standing in front of me?

questions.question: How can I make the internet a kinder place?
match_phrases: how can I make the internet kinder
how can I be kind online
how can I make online spaces better
what can I do to make the internet a nicer place
questions.answer: Use your words to encourage rather than hurt. Don't forward cruel messages, don't join bullying, and speak up when someone is being treated badly. Small acts of kindness can travel a long way online.

topics.title: Finding Balance — Screen Time & Digital Well-being

questions.question: Why do I feel grumpy after playing games for too long?
match_phrases: why do I feel grumpy after gaming
why do games make me irritated
why do I feel bad after playing too long
why am I angry after screen time
why do I feel tired after gaming
questions.answer: Your brain and body need breaks too. After a long stretch of gaming, you may feel tired, restless, or irritable. Taking a break, moving around, drinking water, and doing something away from the screen can help.

questions.question: How do I know when it is time to stop using a screen?
match_phrases: how do I know when to stop screen time
when should I stop using a screen
how much screen time is too much
when should I take a screen break
how do I know I need a break from screens
questions.answer: Listen to your body. Tired eyes, feeling restless, sitting for too long, or ignoring sleep, food, schoolwork, or people around you are good reasons to take a break.

questions.question: Is it okay to use my phone before sleeping?
match_phrases: can I use my phone before sleeping
is using a phone before bed okay
should I use screens before bed
can I watch my phone at night
questions.answer: Using a screen right before bed can make it harder for some people to settle down. A calm, screen-free routine before sleep can help your mind get ready for rest.

questions.question: How can I balance screen time with real life?
match_phrases: how can I balance screen time
how do I balance games and real life
how can I spend less time on screens
how do I balance online and offline activities
how can I make time for things besides screens
questions.answer: Make room for both digital and real-world activities. Learn online, play outside, talk with family, read, create things, move your body, and get enough sleep. A healthy digital life has balance.

topics.title: The Echo Chamber — Fake News & Forwards

questions.question: How do I know if a message is fake news?
match_phrases: how do I know if news is fake
how can I identify fake news
is this forwarded message fake
how do I check if a message is true
how can I tell if a WhatsApp message is fake
questions.answer: Don't believe a message just because it sounds convincing or has been forwarded many times. Check the source, look for an official source, and verify the information before believing or sharing it.

questions.question: Does forwarding a message many times make it true?
match_phrases: does forwarding make something true
if many people forward it is it true
does a viral message mean it is true
can a forwarded message be trusted
questions.answer: No. A message doesn't become true because many people forward it. Repetition is not proof. Remember: Think, Verify, Share.

questions.question: What should I check before forwarding a message?
match_phrases: what should I check before forwarding
how do I verify a message
what should I check before sharing a forward
how can I check if a forwarded message is true
questions.answer: Check three things: the source, whether an official source confirms it, and whether you can verify the claim. If you cannot verify it, don't forward it.

questions.question: What should I do before sharing something online?
match_phrases: what should I do before sharing something online
what should I check before posting
should I share this online
how do I know if something is safe to share
questions.answer: Pause before sharing. Think about whether it is true, check the source, verify important claims, and consider whether sharing it could hurt someone. Think, Verify, Share.

questions.question: Can AI copy someone's voice?
match_phrases: can AI copy a person's voice
can AI clone voices
can AI sound like my mother
how does voice cloning work
can someone fake a voice using AI
questions.answer: Yes. AI can be used to create a voice that sounds like a real person. That's why a familiar voice on a phone call should not automatically be treated as proof that the person is really calling.

questions.question: What if I get a call that sounds exactly like my mother?
match_phrases: what if a call sounds exactly like my mother
what if someone sounds like my mom on the phone
what should I do if my mother's voice is copied
I got a call that sounds like my mother
questions.answer: Don't panic or act immediately. A scammer may be using a copied voice. Use a family safety rule such as your secret family code word, and verify the situation through another trusted way before doing anything.

questions.question: How can I know if a voice call is really from my family?
match_phrases: how do I know a family call is real
how can I verify a family member's voice
how do I know if someone calling is really my family
how can I check if a voice call is genuine
questions.answer: A familiar voice alone is not enough. Ask your family to create a secret code word and use it when something seems unusual. You can also verify by calling the person back through a trusted number.

questions.question: What is a family code word?
match_phrases: what is a family code word
how does a family code word work
why do families need a secret code word
what should our family code word do
questions.answer: It is a secret word or phrase known only to your family. If someone calls claiming to be a family member during an emergency, the code word can help you verify that the caller is really them. Keep the word private.

questions.question: What is a digital arrest scam?
match_phrases: what is a digital arrest scam
what does digital arrest mean
what is a fake digital arrest
how does a digital arrest scam work
questions.answer: It is a scam where someone pretends to be police or another authority and frightens you with claims that you are involved in a crime. The scammer may demand money or personal information. Stay calm, disconnect, and tell a trusted adult.

questions.question: Can the police arrest me over a video call?
match_phrases: can police arrest me on a video call
can someone arrest me over video call
can a police officer arrest me through a video call
is a video call arrest real
questions.answer: A person claiming to be police cannot make a scary video call into proof that you are under arrest. If someone threatens you with a so-called digital arrest, don't follow their instructions. Disconnect and tell a trusted adult immediately.

questions.question: What should I do if someone calls saying I am under digital arrest?
match_phrases: someone says I am under digital arrest
what should I do if someone threatens digital arrest
I got a digital arrest call
someone called saying I am arrested
questions.answer: Disconnect immediately. Don't send money or personal information and don't let the caller frighten you into obeying. Inform a trusted adult and let them handle the situation.

questions.question: Should I stay on the phone if someone threatens me with arrest?
match_phrases: should I stay on a call with someone threatening arrest
should I keep talking to a scammer who threatens me
what if someone threatens me with arrest on the phone
should I hang up a fake police call
questions.answer: No. Threats are meant to make you panic. Stay calm, disconnect the call, and tell a trusted adult. You do not have to solve a frightening call by yourself.

questions.question: What exactly is a tech support scam?
match_phrases: what is a tech support scam
what is fake tech support
how does a tech support scam work
someone says my computer has a virus
questions.answer: It is a scam where someone pretends your computer or phone has a serious problem and tries to frighten you into giving them money, information, or access to your device.

questions.question: Why do scammers ask me to install apps like AnyDesk?
match_phrases: why do scammers ask me to install AnyDesk
why do scammers want remote access
what is AnyDesk used for in scams
why does a scammer want me to install a remote access app
should I install a remote access app for a caller
questions.answer: Remote-access apps can allow another person to control or view a device. A scammer may try to use one to gain access to your computer. Never install a remote-access app because an unexpected caller tells you to.

questions.question: How can I tell if a virus alert is fake?
match_phrases: how do I know if a virus alert is fake
is this virus popup real
what should I do about a scary virus warning
how can I check a fake virus alert
should I call the number on a virus popup
questions.answer: Be suspicious of alarming pop-ups that demand immediate action or tell you to call an unfamiliar number. Don't call the number in the pop-up. Close it and ask a trusted adult to help verify the problem through the device maker's or software company's official support channel.

questions.question: What should I do if I already installed a remote-access app for a stranger?
match_phrases: I already installed a remote access app
what if I installed AnyDesk for a stranger
I gave a stranger remote access
what should I do after installing a remote access app
someone made me install a remote app
questions.answer: Don't panic. Stop communicating with the stranger and tell a trusted adult immediately. They can help disconnect the remote access, remove the app if appropriate, and check whether any accounts or passwords need attention.

questions.question: Do real companies or banks call me out of the blue about a virus?
match_phrases: do real companies call about computer viruses
will my bank call me about a virus
can a company call me unexpectedly about a virus
someone called saying my computer has a virus
is an unexpected tech support call real
questions.answer: An unexpected caller claiming your device has a virus should be treated with suspicion. Don't give them remote access, passwords, OTPs, or payment information. Hang up first and verify through the company's official contact method.

questions.question: Am I good?
match_phrases: am I good
am I a good person
am I a bad person
do you think I am good
questions.answer: You have kindness in you, and every day you get to choose kind actions. That's what makes someone good — not being perfect, but choosing well again and again.

questions.question: Are you good?
match_phrases: are you good
are you nice
are you a good person
are you kind
questions.answer: We try our best to be kind and helpful! We're here to answer your questions and cheer you on.

questions.question: You are bad
match_phrases: you are bad
you are mean
you are stupid
you are not helpful
you are dumb
you are useless
questions.answer: That's okay to say — we won't be upset. If something we said wasn't helpful, try asking in a different way and we'll do our best to help.

questions.question: I don't like you
match_phrases: I dont like you
I hate you
I dont like varsha
I dont like lokesh
I dont want to talk to you
questions.answer: That's okay! You don't have to like us. We're here whenever you have a question, no matter how you feel about us.

questions.question: I love you
match_phrases: I love you
I really like you
you are my best friend
I love talking to you
questions.answer: That's so sweet of you! We enjoy chatting with you too. Remember to share that love with your family and friends as well — they're your real-life cheerleaders.

questions.question: Are you real?
match_phrases: are you real
are you a robot
are you human
are you an ai
are you alive
questions.answer: We're characters made to help you learn and have fun with questions — not real people. For real friendship and support, your family and friends are the best place to turn.

questions.question: Can you be my friend?
match_phrases: can you be my friend
will you be my friend
can we be friends
questions.answer: We'd love to chat with you like friends do! But real friends you can play with, hug, and share your day with are just as important — don't forget to spend time with them too.

questions.question: Why don't you know the answer?
match_phrases: why dont you know
why cant you answer
you dont know anything
why dont you know that
questions.answer: We're still learning new things every day! Our helpers add new answers regularly, so it might be here soon. Thanks for asking — it helps us grow.

questions.question: Who are trusted adults?
match_phrases: who are trusted adults
who is a trusted adult
who can i trust
who should i tell
what is a trusted adult
questions.answer: A trusted adult is someone you already know in real life who keeps you safe — like a parent, guardian, grandparent, teacher, or another family member you can talk to honestly. It's not someone you only know from an app or a game, even if they seem nice. If something online feels wrong, a trusted adult is who you go to first.

questions.question: What counts as personal information?
match_phrases: what counts as personal information
what is personal information
what should i not share online
what information should i keep private
questions.answer: Personal information is anything that could identify you or help a stranger find you — your full name, home address, school name, phone number, passwords, photos of where you live, or your daily routine. Keep these private online, even in games or chats, unless a trusted adult says it's okay to share.

questions.question: What is a pop-up?
match_phrases: what is a pop-up
why is a pop-up dangerous
should i trust a pop-up
what if a pop-up appears
questions.answer: A pop-up is a small window that suddenly appears on your screen — sometimes with scary warnings, prizes, or a number to call. Real security warnings don't panic you into acting fast. If a pop-up feels alarming, don't click it or call any number on it — close the window and tell a trusted adult.

topics.title: Safety Help - When Someone Hurts You
topics.notes: This topic must bypass unknownQuestion fallback. Always match first.

questions.question: Next door man hurt me
match_phrases: next door man hurt me
neighbour hurt me
neighbor hurt me
man hurt me
uncle hurt me
someone hurt me
someone is hurting me
next door uncle hit me
questions.answer: I'm so sorry. It's not your fault. You did right telling me. Please tell your parent, guardian, or teacher right now. If you feel unsafe, call Childline 1098 anytime - it's free.

questions.question: He touched me badly
match_phrases: he touched me badly
she touched me badly
bad touch
touched me in private parts
touched my private parts
uncomfortable touch
someone touched me badly
badly touched me
questions.answer: Thank you for telling me. Bad touch is never your fault. Your body belongs to you. Tell a trusted adult today and don't keep it secret. You can call Childline 1098 for help.

questions.question: Someone is asking for my photos
match_phrases: someone asking for my photos
asking for private photos
send me your photo
send your pics
asking for nude photo
online asking for pics
asking for my picture
questions.answer: Don't send photos. Show the message to a trusted adult right away. Block that person. Call Childline 1098 if they pressure you.

questions.question: I feel unsafe
match_phrases: i feel unsafe
i am scared
i feel not safe
i need help
i feel unsafe at home
i feel unsafe at school
i am afraid
questions.answer: If you feel unsafe, find a trusted adult near you now. Move to a safe place if you can. You can call Childline 1098 anytime. You deserve to be safe.

questions.question: Someone told me to keep a secret about touching
match_phrases: told me to keep secret
said dont tell anyone
secret about touching
threatened me to keep secret
don't tell secret
questions.answer: Secrets about touching should not be kept. You won't get in trouble for telling. Tell a trusted adult today. Call 1098 for help.

questions.question: Someone is scaring me online
match_phrases: someone scaring me online
threatening me online
blackmailing me
someone scaring me in game
scaring me on chat
questions.answer: Don't reply. Take a screenshot if you can and show a trusted adult. Block and report that person. Call 1098 for help.

questions.question: He is asking me to meet alone
match_phrases: asking me to meet alone
wants to meet me alone
told me to meet outside
meet me secretly
questions.answer: Don't go alone. Tell a trusted adult about this message right away. Don't keep meeting plans secret. Call 1098 if you need help.

questions.question: What is good touch and bad touch?
match_phrases: what is good touch bad touch
what is bad touch
what is safe touch
difference good bad touch
questions.answer: Good touch feels safe and caring, like a hug from family when you want it. Bad touch hurts, feels uncomfortable, or touches private parts. If bad touch happens, say no and tell a trusted adult. Call 1098.
